name: Apply Trim Primer (Brush Method)
intent: Spot-prime knots in solid wood (only), then brush prime the entire trim. Brush is the slow, controlled method — ~4x slower per LF than spray but no masking required.
doctrine: MDF edge seal only fires for bare MDF because MDF cores absorb primer like a sponge if not sealed first; solid wood and factory-primed don't have exposed MDF core. Knot spot-priming only fires for bare solid wood — knots need shellac-based primer to block tannin bleed. The general brush prime task applies regardless of condition. 90 LF/hr is the brush trim rate baseline.
